sample-pages.pdf.purpose: Two pages: portrait 612x792 and landscape 792x612; blue/red rectangles, headings and end markers.

sample-pages.ps.purpose: Two PostScript pages matching the PDF shapes and markers; full vector/document rendering is planned.

sample-vector.eps.purpose: Single 300x200 vector EPS: blue rectangle, red circle and heading; full vector rendering is planned.

sample-equations.tex.purpose: Self-contained two-page LaTeX article: formatting, equations, list, table and footnote; typeset rendering is planned.

invalid-document.pdf.purpose: Negative check: clear open error; no crash or stuck spinner.
